meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 收到文本后,Claude 会剖析写作者的思考方式,在 12 个认知维度(逻辑、创意、共情等)上逐项打 1–10 分,并给出包含思维强弱项、推理路径和决策习惯的认知档案。
howto.when: 当你想了解或对比一个人的思考方式,或想解读一段文字背后的认知特征时触发;直接问“我的思维风格”或提到 DHDNA 也会触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字的思考方式。
say.note: 会输出各维度打分和认知档案。

say.text: 用我们的聊天记录,给我分析下我的思维方式。
say.note: 会基于对话历史做自我分析。

say.text: 比较这两篇文章作者的思考风格。
say.note: 会生成两份档案并对比异同。

howto.what_en: Examines a text's cognitive style, scores 12 dimensions (logic, creativity, etc.) 1–10, and returns a profile with dominant patterns, blind spots, reasoning topology, and decision approach.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to understand or compare how someone thinks, decode a text's cognitive traits, asks “what's my thinking style”, or mentions DHDNA / digital DNA.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style in this text.
say_en.note: Returns dimension scores and a cognitive profile.

say_en.text: Using our chat history, profile how I think.
Compare the thinking styles of these two texts.
say_en.note: Produces two profiles and a comparison.
